summary: Tested advanced ecommerce checkout and order system with COD partial payment, fraud prevention, delivery optimization, and prepaid incentive strategy. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for checkout page (PIN code auto-fill, payment method selection, COD advance breakdown, prepaid discount), admin checkout settings panel (6 settings cards, high-risk orders tab), and order success page.

checkout_settings_routes.py: COD eligibility checks pending orders count and cancelled orders for fraud prevention
order_routes.py: Risk scoring correctly flags COD orders above high_risk_threshold as 'high' risk
order_routes.py: COD advance calculation (Rs.500 for orders >= Rs.1000) working correctly
CheckoutPage.jsx: PIN code auto-fill working with data-testid='input-pincode'
CheckoutPage.jsx: Payment method cards show SAVE badge for prepaid and +Rs.49 fee for COD

CheckoutPage.jsx: 'Switch to online payment & save' nudge (data-testid='switch-to-prepaid-nudge') appears when COD selected
AdminCheckoutSettingsPanel.jsx: 6 settings cards (COD, COD Advance, Prepaid, Fraud, Shipping, Messages)
AdminCheckoutSettingsPanel.jsx: High-Risk Orders tab shows flagged orders with approve/hold/cancel buttons
OrderSuccessPage.jsx: Correctly displays prepaid discount and COD fee in order breakdown
